title.sub: At the Moon's south pole, the Sun barely clears the hills.

clips.caption: Luna Atlas tells you: can we land here, and when?
Stand on the site: the Sun and Earth skim the real skyline.
Compare sites: sunlight on a panel, and Earth in view.
Launch slipped a month? It finds the next window, here or nearby.
Malapert's published point sees no Earth. 10.7 km east, Earth is in view 70% of the time.
Our shadows match 5 of 6 NASA LRO photos.

end.sub: Built on NASA data, and checked against it.
